title: Cook and Count Letters
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool cooking-tools storybook, bright utensils and ingredients, child-safe presentation, segmentation-friendly spacing

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: sequence cue -> recall beat -> target -> count/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a soft cupboard-click plus acoustic-pluck shelf answer after the word.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a soft cupboard-click plus acoustic-pluck shelf answer after the word
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Cook and Count Letters about measurement and transformation: volume, timing, rolling, mixing, heating and ingredient changes are separated, with US quart explicitly labeled.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows measure -> wait -> mix -> shape -> heat while adults own hot/sharp steps.
